name: Ramblings
source:
After committing suicide, Juni finds herself before an ancient deity, hellbent on forcing Juni to see the wrongfulness of both her choices and the way she treated her friends.

[From [url=https://floofy-loofy.itch.io/ramblings]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
自杀后，朱尼发现自己面对着一位古老的神灵，他决意要迫使朱尼看到她的选择和她对待朋友的方式都是错误的。

[来自[url=https://floofy-loofy.itch.io/ramblings]Itch.io[/url]]
